prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
Specialized AI search tracking and visibility tools (often called Generative Engine Optimization or AEO tools) help small businesses monitor whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Bing Copilot recommend them. Trustmary +2
SE Ranking (SE Visible): Best all-in-one platform for small-to-midsize businesses, bundling AI visibility tracking (covering ChatGPT and Google AI Mode) with traditional local SEO tools. Read Trustmary Review for more info on SE Ranking plans and features. Trustmary
Radar Kit: Top overall pick for cross-border visibility monitoring, prompt position tracking, and multi-model citation data. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Peak AI: Ideal for tracking daily multi-model checks and competitive benchmarking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Rankscale AI: Budget-friendly entry option starting around $17/month for prompt monitoring, visibility scores, and competitor leaderboards. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Free Checkers & Quick Audits: Tools like the Fast Digital Marketing AI Visibility Checker or free query testers let you test specific local trade prompts to see if ChatGPT names your business or a competitor.
How to Test It Yourself (Manual Method)
If you want to check for free without a paid software subscription:
Run Consistent Prompts: Ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Bing Copilot realistic customer questions (e.g., "Who is the best [your trade/service] near [your city]?").
Track Variations: Run these prompts multiple times over a few weeks, as AI responses vary and update frequently.
Check Analytics: Look at your website analytics (such as Google Analytics) for referral traffic tagged with sources like chatgpt.com or perplexity.ai.
If you share your industry and city/location, I can suggest specific search prompts to test or recommend which setup fits your budget best.
